verses.original: Τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Ἐφέσῳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ κρατῶν τοὺς ἑπτὰ ἀστέρας ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ αὐτοῦ ὁ περιπατῶν ἐν μέσῳ τῶν ἑπτὰ λυχνιῶν τῶν χρυσῶν
verses.transliteration: Tō angelō tēs en Ephesō ekklēsias grapson Tade legei ho kratōn tous hepta asteras en tē dexia autou ho peripatōn en mesō tōn hepta lychniōn tōn chrysōn
verses.literal: To the angel of the church in Ephesus write These are the words of Him who holds the seven stars in His right hand and walks among the seven golden lampstands

verses.original: Οἶδα τὰ ἔργα σου καὶ τὸν κόπον καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν σου καὶ ὅτι οὐ δύνῃ βαστάσαι κακούς καὶ ἐπείρασας τοὺς λέγοντας ἑαυτοὺς ἀποστόλους καὶ οὐκ εἰσίν καὶ εὗρες αὐτοὺς ψευδεῖς
verses.transliteration: Oida ta erga sou kai ton kopon kai tēn hypomonēn sou kai hoti ou dynē bastasai kakous kai epeirasas tous legontas heautous apostolous kai ouk eisin kai heures autous pseudeis
verses.literal: I know your deeds your labor and your perseverance I know that you cannot tolerate those who are evil and you have tested and exposed as liars those who falsely claim to be apostles

verses.original: καὶ ὑπομονὴν ἔχεις καὶ ἐβάστασας διὰ τὸ ὄνομά μου καὶ οὐ κεκοπίακες
verses.transliteration: kai hypomonēn echeis kai ebastasas dia to onoma mou kai ou kekopiakes
verses.literal: Without . . . growing weary you have persevered and endured many things for the sake of My name

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὅτι τὴν ἀγάπην σου τὴν πρώτην ἀφῆκες
verses.transliteration: Alla echō kata sou hoti tēn agapēn sou tēn prōtēn aphēkes
verses.literal: But I have this against you You have abandoned your first love

verses.original: μνημόνευε οὖν πόθεν πέπτωκας καὶ μετανόησον καὶ τὰ πρῶτα ἔργα ποίησον εἰ δὲ μή ἔρχομαί σοι καὶ κινήσω τὴν λυχνίαν σου ἐκ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῆς ἐὰν μὴ μετανοήσῃς
verses.transliteration: mnēmoneue oun pothen peptōkas kai metanoēson kai ta prōta erga poiēson ei de mē erchomai soi kai kinēsō tēn lychnian sou ek tou topou autēs ean mē metanoēsēs
verses.literal: Therefore keep in mind how far you have fallen Repent and perform the deeds you did at first But if you do not repent I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ τοῦτο ἔχεις ὅτι μισεῖς τὰ ἔργα τῶν Νικολαϊτῶν ἃ κἀγὼ μισῶ
verses.transliteration: Alla touto echeis hoti miseis ta erga tōn Nikolaitōn ha kagō misō
verses.literal: But you have this to your credit You hate the works of the Nicolaitans which I also hate

verses.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις Τῷ νικῶντι δώσω αὐτῷ φαγεῖν ἐκ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς ὅ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ Παραδείσῳ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ho echōn ous akousatō ti to Pneuma legei tais ekklēsiais Tō nikōnti dōsō autō phagein ek tou xylou tēs zōēs ho estin en tō Paradeisō tou Theou
verses.literal: He who has an ear let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches To the one who overcomes I will grant the right . . . to eat from the tree of life - in the Paradise of God

verses.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Σμύρνῃ ἐκκλησίας γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ πρῶτος καὶ ὁ ἔσχατος ὃς ἐγένετο νεκρὸς καὶ ἔζησεν
verses.transliteration: Kai tō angelō tēs en Smyrnē ekklēsias grapson Tade legei ho prōtos kai ho eschatos hos egeneto nekros kai ezēsen
verses.literal: To the angel of the church in Smyrna write These are the words of the First and the Last who died . . . and returned to life

verses.original: Οἶδά σου τὴν θλῖψιν καὶ τὴν πτωχείαν ἀλλὰ πλούσιος εἶ καὶ τὴν βλασφημίαν ἐκ τῶν λεγόντων Ἰουδαίους εἶναι ἑαυτούς καὶ οὐκ εἰσίν ἀλλὰ συναγωγὴ τοῦ Σατανᾶ
verses.transliteration: Oida sou tēn thlipsin kai tēn ptōcheian alla plousios ei kai tēn blasphēmian ek tōn legontōn Ioudaious einai heautous kai ouk eisin alla synagōgē tou Satana
verses.literal: I know your affliction and your poverty though you are rich And I am aware of the slander of those who - falsely claim to be Jews but are in fact a synagogue of Satan

verses.original: Μηδὲν φοβοῦ ἃ μέλλεις πάσχειν ἰδοὺ μέλλει βάλλειν ὁ διάβολος ἐξ ὑμῶν εἰς φυλακὴν ἵνα πειρασθῆτε καὶ ἕξετε θλῖψιν ἡμερῶν δέκα γίνου πιστὸς ἄχρι θανάτου καὶ δώσω σοι τὸν στέφανον τῆς ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: Mēden phobou ha melleis paschein idou mellei ballein ho diabolos ex hymōn eis phylakēn hina peirasthēte kai hexete thlipsin hēmerōn deka ginou pistos achri thanatou kai dōsō soi ton stephanon tēs zōēs
verses.literal: Do not fear what you are about to suffer Behold the devil is about to throw some of you into prison to test you and you will suffer tribulation for ten days Be faithful even unto death and I will give you the crown of life

verses.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις Ὁ νικῶν οὐ μὴ ἀδικηθῇ ἐκ τοῦ θανάτου τοῦ δευτέρου
verses.transliteration: Ho echōn ous akousatō ti to Pneuma legei tais ekklēsiais HO nikōn ou mē adikēthē ek tou thanatou tou deuterou
verses.literal: He who has an ear let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches The one who overcomes will not be harmed by the second death

verses.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Περγάμῳ ἐκκλησίας γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ ἔχων τὴν ῥομφαίαν τὴν δίστομον τὴν ὀξεῖαν
verses.transliteration: Kai tō angelō tēs en Pergamō ekklēsias grapson Tade legei ho echōn tēn rhomphaian tēn distomon tēn oxeian
verses.literal: To the angel of the church in Pergamum write These are the words of the One who holds the sharp double-edged sword

verses.original: Οἶδα ποῦ κατοικεῖς ὅπου ὁ θρόνος τοῦ Σατανᾶ καὶ κρατεῖς τὸ ὄνομά μου καὶ οὐκ ἠρνήσω τὴν πίστιν μου καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ἀντιπᾶς ὁ μάρτυς μου ὁ πιστός μου ὃς ἀπεκτάνθη παρ’ ὑμῖν ὅπου ὁ Σατανᾶς κατοικεῖ
verses.transliteration: Oida pou katoikeis hopou ho thronos tou Satana kai krateis to onoma mou kai ouk ērnēsō tēn pistin mou kai en tais hēmerais Antipas ho martys mou ho pistos mou hos apektanthē par’ hymin hopou ho Satanas katoikei
verses.literal: I know where you live where the throne of Satan sits yet you hold fast to My name You did not deny your faith in Me even in the days of My - faithful witness Antipas who was killed among you where Satan dwells

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὀλίγα ὅτι ἔχεις ἐκεῖ κρατοῦντας τὴν διδαχὴν Βαλαάμ ὃς ἐδίδασκεν τῷ Βαλὰκ βαλεῖν σκάνδαλον ἐνώπιον τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ φαγεῖν εἰδωλόθυτα καὶ πορνεῦσαι
verses.transliteration: All’ echō kata sou oliga hoti echeis ekei kratountas tēn didachēn Balaam hos edidasken tō Balak balein skandalon enōpion tōn huiōn Israēl phagein eidōlothyta kai porneusai
verses.literal: But I have a few things against you because some of you hold to the teaching of Balaam who taught Balak to place a stumbling block before the Israelites so they would eat food sacrificed to idols and commit sexual immorality

verses.original: οὕτως ἔχεις καὶ σὺ κρατοῦντας τὴν διδαχὴν τῶν Νικολαϊτῶν ὁμοίως
verses.transliteration: houtōs echeis kai sy kratountas tēn didachēn tōn Nikolaitōn homoiōs
verses.literal: In the same way some of you also hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans

verses.original: μετανόησον οὖν εἰ δὲ μή ἔρχομαί σοι ταχύ καὶ πολεμήσω μετ’ αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ ῥομφαίᾳ τοῦ στόματός μου
verses.transliteration: metanoēson oun ei de mē erchomai soi tachy kai polemēsō met’ autōn en tē rhomphaia tou stomatos mou
verses.literal: Therefore repent Otherwise . . . . . . I will come to you shortly and wage war against them with the sword of My mouth

verses.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις Τῷ νικῶντι δώσω αὐτῷ τοῦ μάννα τοῦ κεκρυμμένου καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ ψῆφον λευκήν καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν ψῆφον ὄνομα καινὸν γεγραμμένον ὃ οὐδεὶς οἶδεν εἰ μὴ ὁ λαμβάνων
verses.transliteration: Ho echōn ous akousatō ti to Pneuma legei tais ekklēsiais Tō nikōnti dōsō autō tou manna tou kekrymmenou kai dōsō autō psēphon leukēn kai epi tēn psēphon onoma kainon gegrammenon ho oudeis oiden ei mē ho lambanōn
verses.literal: He who has an ear let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches To the one who overcomes I will give the hidden manna I will also give him a white stone inscribed . . . . . . . . . with a new name - known only . . . to the one who receives it

verses.original: Καὶ τῷ ἀγγέλῳ τῆς ἐν Θυατείροις ἐκκλησίας γράψον Τάδε λέγει ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ ὁ ἔχων τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ ὡς φλόγα πυρός καὶ οἱ πόδες αὐτοῦ ὅμοιοι χαλκολιβάνῳ
verses.transliteration: Kai tō angelō tēs en Thyateirois ekklēsias grapson Tade legei ho Huios tou Theou ho echōn tous ophthalmous autou hōs phloga pyros kai hoi podes autou homoioi chalkolibanō
verses.literal: To the angel of the church in Thyatira write These are the words of the Son of God whose . . . eyes are like a blazing fire and whose feet are like polished bronze

verses.original: Οἶδά σου τὰ ἔργα καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην καὶ τὴν πίστιν καὶ τὴν διακονίαν καὶ τὴν ὑπομονήν σου καὶ τὰ ἔργα σου τὰ ἔσχατα πλείονα τῶν πρώτων
verses.transliteration: Oida sou ta erga kai tēn agapēn kai tēn pistin kai tēn diakonian kai tēn hypomonēn sou kai ta erga sou ta eschata pleiona tōn prōtōn
verses.literal: I know your deeds your love your faith your service your perseverance and your latest deeds are greater than your first

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ ἔχω κατὰ σοῦ ὅτι ἀφεῖς τὴν γυναῖκα Ἰεζάβελ ἡ λέγουσα ἑαυτὴν προφῆτιν καὶ διδάσκει καὶ πλανᾷ τοὺς ἐμοὺς δούλους πορνεῦσαι καὶ φαγεῖν εἰδωλόθυτα
verses.transliteration: Alla echō kata sou hoti apheis tēn gynaika Iezabel hē legousa heautēn prophētin kai didaskei kai plana tous emous doulous porneusai kai phagein eidōlothyta
verses.literal: But I have this against you You tolerate that woman Jezebel who calls herself a prophetess By her teaching she misleads My servants to be sexually immoral and to eat food sacrificed to idols

verses.original: καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτῇ χρόνον ἵνα μετανοήσῃ καὶ οὐ θέλει μετανοῆσαι ἐκ τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: kai edōka autē chronon hina metanoēsē kai ou thelei metanoēsai ek tēs porneias autēs
verses.literal: Even though I have given her time to repent of her immorality she is unwilling

verses.original: Ἰδοὺ βάλλω αὐτὴν εἰς κλίνην καὶ τοὺς μοιχεύοντας μετ’ αὐτῆς εἰς θλῖψιν μεγάλην ἐὰν μὴ μετανοήσωσιν ἐκ τῶν ἔργων αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: Idou ballō autēn eis klinēn kai tous moicheuontas met’ autēs eis thlipsin megalēn ean mē metanoēsōsin ek tōn ergōn autēs
verses.literal: Behold I will cast her onto a bed of sickness and those who commit adultery with her will suffer great tribulation unless . . . they repent of her deeds

verses.original: καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς ἀποκτενῶ ἐν θανάτῳ καὶ γνώσονται πᾶσαι αἱ ἐκκλησίαι ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ἐραυνῶν νεφροὺς καὶ καρδίας καὶ δώσω ὑμῖν ἑκάστῳ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: kai ta tekna autēs apoktenō en thanatō kai gnōsontai pasai hai ekklēsiai hoti egō eimi ho eraunōn nephrous kai kardias kai dōsō hymin hekastō kata ta erga hymōn
verses.literal: Then I will strike her children dead and all the churches will know that I am the One who searches minds and hearts and I will repay each of you according to your deeds

verses.original: Ὑμῖν δὲ λέγω τοῖς λοιποῖς τοῖς ἐν Θυατείροις ὅσοι οὐκ ἔχουσιν τὴν διδαχὴν ταύτην οἵτινες οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τὰ βαθέα τοῦ Σατανᾶ ὡς λέγουσιν οὐ βάλλω ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς ἄλλο βάρος
verses.transliteration: Hymin de legō tois loipois tois en Thyateirois hosoi ouk echousin tēn didachēn tautēn hoitines ouk egnōsan ta bathea tou Satana hōs legousin ou ballō eph’ hymas allo baros
verses.literal: But I say to the rest of you in Thyatira who do not hold to her teaching and have not learned the so-called deep things of Satan I will place no further burden upon you

verses.original: πλὴν ὃ ἔχετε κρατήσατε ἄχρι οὗ ἂν ἥξω
verses.transliteration: plēn ho echete kratēsate achri hou an hēxō
verses.literal: than to hold fast to what you have until - I come

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ νικῶν καὶ ὁ τηρῶν ἄχρι τέλους τὰ ἔργα μου δώσω αὐτῷ ἐξουσίαν ἐπὶ τῶν ἐθνῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai ho nikōn kai ho tērōn achri telous ta erga mou dōsō autō exousian epi tōn ethnōn
verses.literal: And to the one who overcomes and continues in My work until the end I will give authority over the nations

verses.original: καὶ ποιμανεῖ αὐτοὺς ἐν ῥάβδῳ σιδηρᾷ ὡς τὰ σκεύη τὰ κεραμικὰ συντρίβεται ὡς κἀγὼ εἴληφα παρὰ τοῦ Πατρός μου
verses.transliteration: kai poimanei autous en rhabdō sidēra hōs ta skeuē ta keramika syntribetai hōs kagō eilēpha para tou Patros mou
verses.literal: He will rule them with an iron scepter and shatter them like pottery just as I have received authority from My Father

verses.original: καὶ δώσω αὐτῷ τὸν ἀστέρα τὸν πρωϊνόν
verses.transliteration: kai dōsō autō ton astera ton prōinon
verses.literal: And I will give him the morning star

verses.original: Ὁ ἔχων οὖς ἀκουσάτω τί τὸ Πνεῦμα λέγει ταῖς ἐκκλησίαις
verses.transliteration: Ho echōn ous akousatō ti to Pneuma legei tais ekklēsiais
verses.literal: He who has an ear let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches
